upgrades.name: 👑 Royal Throne
upgrades.description: Carved from the finest oak. Cements your reign.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Wood Bank
upgrades.description: For each 1000 🪵 you have, gain 1% base 🪵/sec

upgrades.name: 🌱 Ale Bank
upgrades.description: For each 1000 🍺 you have, gain 1% base 🍺/sec

upgrades.name: 🌳 Timed schedule
upgrades.description:
A global multiplier that increased as time pass after its purchase
(minute gives 10% boost (base))

upgrades.name: 🌳 Better timing
upgrades.description: Increase the time bonus factor for new seconds

upgrades.name: 🌳 Retro time
upgrades.description: The better time factor now works retro which give big bonus.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ First Generation
upgrades.description: Unlock the Generators Panel and give access to G1 and G2.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Second Generation
upgrades.description: Give access to G3 and G4.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Pyramid
upgrades.description: Lower tier G give boost to higher tiers.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Socialism
upgrades.description: Gain a boost that grows the more evenly your generators are owned, peaking when they all have the same amount.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Capitalism
upgrades.description: The generator with the highest amount gain additional boost.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Stronger Click
upgrades.description: Clicking give +1 more resource per click.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Smarter Click
upgrades.description: Clicking give *1.1 more resource per click.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Lantern
upgrades.description: Unlock the lantern: it refills while nothing is highlighted and burns while a resource is. Highlight income is ×1.5 while it holds oil.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Brighter Flame
upgrades.description: The lit lantern boosts highlight income by a further +0.25×.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Bigger Reservoir
upgrades.description: The lantern holds 5 more oil, so it burns 5 seconds longer.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Quicker Refill
upgrades.description: Refill 0.5 more oil per second while nothing is highlighted.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Slower Burn
upgrades.description: Burn 10% less oil per second while a resource is highlighted.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Full Flame
upgrades.description: +0.5× more while the lantern is at least three-quarters full. Rewards short bursts.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Last Drop
upgrades.description: +0.5× more while the lantern is down to its last quarter. Rewards long holds.

upgrades.name: 🕵 First Spy
upgrades.description: Unlock Espionage Panel and See enemy main resource (maybe move the espionage unlocks to the espionage panel itself)

upgrades.name: 🕵 Better Spy
upgrades.description: See enemy main resources per sec.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Better second spy
upgrades.description: See enemy secondary resources per sec.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Purchase receipts
upgrades.description: A popup when enemy purchase generator or upgrade.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Upgrade/Generator
upgrades.description: The popup differs when enemy purchase upgrade or generator.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Know the generator
upgrades.description: The popup tells which generator the enemy brought.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Know the upgrade
upgrades.description: The popup tells which upgrade the enemy brought.

upgrades.name: 🛡️ Early warning
upgrades.description: Get warned 5 seconds before an enemy attack lands on you. Unlocks after you have been hit once.

upgrades.name: 🛡️ Know the attack
upgrades.description: The warning names the incoming attack.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Gotta click fast
upgrades.description: Gain additional click income as your peak cps.

upgrades.name: 🏮 Borrowed Glow
upgrades.description: Sign Borrowed Glow: your highlight grows with the enemy's peak click speed.

upgrades.name: 🔎 Shared Lens
upgrades.description: Sign Shared Lens: +2 click income per enemy Clearer Lens level, both ways.

upgrades.name: 📜 Shared research
upgrades.description: Sign Shared research: upgrades the enemy owns cost you 25% less.

upgrades.name: 🪵 Trade route
upgrades.description: Sign Trade route: +2% wood per enemy woodcutter, both ways.

upgrades.name: ✋ Numb Hands
upgrades.description: Unlock Numb Hands: a 15s click blackout.

upgrades.name: 🌫️ Fog of War
upgrades.description: Unlock Fog of War: halve their highlight for 8s.

upgrades.name: 🐛 Termite Swarm
upgrades.description: Unlock Termite Swarm: −22% enemy Wood for 67s.

upgrades.name: 🚫 Embargo
upgrades.description: Unlock Embargo: the enemy can buy nothing for 10s.

attacks.name: Steal Wood
attacks.description: Steal enemy's wood. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Second Attack
attacks.description: Steal enemy's ale. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: First Passive Attack
attacks.description: Passively reduces the enemy's Wood production by 10% while unlocked.

attacks.name: Raid Woodcutters
attacks.description: Steal half the enemy's Woodcutters — they produce for you from now on. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Poach Sawmill
attacks.description: Steal one of the enemy's Sawmills, even one you haven't unlocked yourself. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Less Click Power
attacks.description: Passively halves the enemy's per-click income while unlocked.

attacks.name: Less Click Power (flat)
attacks.description: Passively takes a flat 2 off the enemy's per-click income while unlocked.

attacks.name: Dim Highlight
attacks.description: Passively cuts the enemy's highlight bonus in half while unlocked.

attacks.name: Dim Highlight (flat)
attacks.description: Passively subtracts 1 from the enemy's highlight factor while unlocked — enough to cancel a small highlight's bonus, though never below a neutral ×1.

attacks.name: Fog of War
attacks.description: Halves the enemy's highlight bonus for 8s.

attacks.name: Embargo
attacks.description: The enemy cannot buy upgrades or generators for 10s. Time it for when they are saving up.

pacts.name: Borrowed Glow
pacts.description: Your highlight grows with the enemy's fastest clicking: +120% per click/s of their peak.

pacts.name: Shared Lens
pacts.description: +2 click income per level of the enemy's Clearer Lens. The enemy gains the same from yours.

pacts.name: Shared research
pacts.description: Upgrades the enemy already owns cost 25% less for you, while they stay ahead.

pacts.name: Trade route
pacts.description: +2% wood per enemy woodcutter, up to +50%. The enemy gains the same from yours.
